title: GPT image requests get smarter routing
summary:
A small garden-maintenance day: smarter GPT image routing, a newly listed community app, and account foundations taking root.

The GPT image endpoint now uses stage-based routing, laying out a clearer path for requests to reach the right generation setup instead of wandering through the plumbing.

The project directory now includes AI Content Describer, making one more community-built tool easier to find.

A user tier system landed, establishing the account structure needed to tailor access and experiences as the platform grows.
